name: Otosareta Hitozuma Mei - Haitoku no Kairaku ni Honrousare, Saiaizuma wa Midara ni Iki Kuruu
original_name: 堕とされた人妻・芽衣 背徳の快楽に翻弄され、最愛妻は淫らにイキ狂う
source:
Makoto and Mei met through an arranged marriage and got married.
Given their natural personalities, they got along well, respected each other, and led a peaceful married life.
However, Mei had a small worry, even though she knew she was living a life of luxury.
She knew she was cherished. But she wondered if he really needed her—
Just then, Makoto was scheduled to go on a business trip…

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ015379]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
慎与芽衣经由相亲结识，并顺理成章地步入了婚姻殿堂。
得益于两人温厚随和的天性，夫妻俩感情融洽、相敬如宾，过着平静安稳的新婚生活。
然而，明知自己如今衣食无忧、备受呵护，芽衣心底却仍藏着一抹小小的不安。
她知道丈夫很珍惜自己，却不禁暗自怀疑——他真的需要自己吗——
就在这时，慎接到了出差远行的安排……
